nodes.description: Constant state variable MAX_UINT set to 2**256 - 1 in NotCoin; used as the returned supply/balance/allowance value.
Public string state variable holding the token name, written in the NotCoin constructor.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol, written in the NotCoin constructor.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals, written in the NotCoin constructor.
Constructor of the NotCoin contract; assigns _name, _symbol and _decimals to the name, symbol and decimals state variables.
Public view function returning the constant MAX_UINT as the total supply, ignoring any real accounting.
Public view function that ignores the _owner argument and always returns MAX_UINT as the balance.
Public transfer function with no balance tracking or checks; emits Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value) and returns true unconditionally.
Public approve function that stores no allowance; emits Approval(msg.sender, _spender, _value) and returns true unconditionally.
Public view function that ignores _owner and _spender and always returns MAX_UINT.
Public transferFrom function that performs no allowance or balance checks; emits Transfer(_from, _to, _value) and returns true unconditionally.
Caller-controlled address used as the from/owner argument in the Transfer and Approval events emitted by transfer() and approve().
Transfer event emission inside transfer(); publishes a transfer of arbitrary value from msg.sender to an arbitrary address without any balance verification.
Approval event emission inside approve(); publishes an arbitrary allowance from msg.sender to an arbitrary spender without persisting any allowance state.
Transfer event emission inside transferFrom(); publishes a transfer from an arbitrary _from address without allowance or ownership verification.
Constructor parameter _name, assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol, assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _decimals, assigned to the decimals state variable.
balanceOf parameter _owner; unused, the function always returns MAX_UINT.
transfer parameter _to, forwarded into the Transfer event.
transfer parameter _value, forwarded into the Transfer event without validation.
approve parameter _spender, forwarded into the Approval event.
approve parameter _value, forwarded into the Approval event without validation.
allowance parameter _owner; unused, the function always returns MAX_UINT.
allowance parameter _spender; unused, the function always returns MAX_UINT.
transferFrom parameter _from, forwarded into the Transfer event without any owner verification.
transferFrom parameter _to, forwarded into the Transfer event.
transferFrom parameter _value, forwarded into the Transfer event without validation.
Named return variable balance of balanceOf; never assigned, function always returns MAX_UINT.
